errors.evidence: The vertical axis has no label. The text 'Валеж (l/m²)' is the title of the entire chart, not the y-axis label.
The chart shows no bar for the date 3/10/2024, meaning the precipitation value is 0, not approximately 1.2 l/m².
The bar for 3/7/2024 is visibly above the 10.00 line, at approximately 10.5 l/m². Reporting it as 'около 10.0 l/m²' is an understatement.
The value for 3/8/2024 is exactly 0 (there is no bar), not 'almost zero' (почти нулеви).
The bar for 3/13/2024 reaches approximately 2.5 l/m², which is significantly higher than the reported 'около 2.0 l/m²'.
While the value for 3/14/2024 is small and positive ('almost zero' is acceptable), the value for 3/15/2024 is exactly 0, so describing it as 'almost zero' (почти нулеви) is inaccurate.
